name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's motorsport journey began in the dusty karting tracks of Soweto, where he volunteered as a mechanic's assistant, fueled by a burning passion for speed and engineering. His meticulous attention to detail and organizational prowess quickly became apparent, leading him to pursue a career in logistics. Over the past two decades, he's honed his skills working for various racing teams across Africa and Europe, managing everything from equipment transportation to pit crew scheduling. 

Known for his unflappable demeanor under pressure, Thabo excels at anticipating logistical challenges and implementing proactive solutions. He believes that a well-coordinated logistics operation is the backbone of any successful racing team, ensuring that every component and personnel are in the right place at the right time. His dedication to precision and efficiency makes him an invaluable asset, capable of turning logistical nightmares into seamless victories. Thabo is a perfectionist and always strives for improvements in the field of motorsport logistics.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped afro with slight greying at the temples
physical.description: Thabo is a powerfully built man with a calm, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn notebook filled with meticulously detailed schedules.
Insists on double-checking every manifest and itinerary, even when others assure him it's correct.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often in sync with the engine sounds.
